The last residuals are about 1e-14 for U and 1e-10 for p. Errors from iterations and time-stepping are negligible next to the grid error.

| Grid | u(y=0.5) |
|---|---|
| 40×40 | −0.2051463 |
| 80×80 | −0.2081288 |
| 160×160 | −0.2088918 |
